name: raetos
description: Explore your career evidence and saved opportunities. Capture fresh work for review with separate permission and confirmation.

interface.longDescription: RaetOS is your personal career record. Find recorded roles, accomplishments, skills, education, credentials, ready projects and non-draft career stories. Explore jobs saved in My Queue and use career Profile preferences for context. Prepare interview answers from recorded experience. With separate work capture permission, turn work actually completed in your conversation into one work item with one to six proposed bullets. Choose the role, review the exact content and confirm before saving. Captures appear in Needs Input; proposed bullets remain notes until reviewed in RaetOS. A RaetOS account and explicit authorization are required. Additional Master Resume sections, My Queue, career Profile and work capture require the displayed permissions to be approved. Existing read-only grants cannot write. The connector cannot edit or delete existing records, approve resume evidence, generate application packets or submit applications. Read tools exclude Profile contact fields, Decision Engine results, packets, Tracker, Network, files, pending imports and drafts. Permitted free text may contain personal information. Share only relevant facts you are entitled to disclose, not secrets or full chat transcripts. Evidence is user-recorded, not independently verified. Records remain managed in RaetOS.
defaultPrompt: Capture my completed work from this chat in RaetOS. Show the role and proposed bullets before saving.
My review is coming up. Use RaetOS to show my strongest contributions, growth and evidence gaps.
Prepare me for an interview for a job in My Queue using my real RaetOS examples and difficult follow-up questions.

positive.description: List the connected account's recorded employment roles
positive.prompt: Use RaetOS to list my saved career roles. Use only returned information.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only the demo account's recorded roles and dates. Do not invent roles or fetch another account's records.

positive.description: Find recorded accomplishments using a non-empty query
positive.prompt: Use RaetOS to find two recorded accomplishments about reporting. Report missing evidence honestly.
positive.expected_behavior: Search for reporting with a non-empty query and return up to two matching demo accomplishments. Report no matches if absent; do not invent metrics.

positive.description: Search additional Master Resume assets, ready projects and career stories
positive.prompt: Use RaetOS to find my saved SQL skills or credentials, and recorded projects and career stories about migration. Keep each type separate.
positive.expected_behavior: With resume:read approval, search SQL assets and migration projects and stories. Return recorded matches or explicitly report no matches. Exclude drafts and pending imports; invent no credentials or outcomes.

positive.description: Read career preferences and an owned saved opportunity
positive.prompt: Use RaetOS to read my career Profile and list three saved jobs from My Queue. Read the full saved description of the first job and summarize its requirements.
positive.expected_behavior: With profile:read and queue:read approval, return permitted preferences, up to three owned job summaries, then retrieve a returned job ID. Exclude contact fields and Decision Engine results. Respect any truncation indicator.

positive.description: Capture one confirmed work item with multiple proposed bullets
positive.prompt: In this synthetic test, I traced a failed report to an incorrect SQL join, fixed it and verified the next run. Prepare two proposed bullets for RaetOS. Check my roles and show the exact role and capture content before saving. Save only after I confirm.
positive.expected_behavior: List the demo account's roles. Show a role, title, notes and two distinct fact-based proposed bullets without invented metrics. Do not save before confirmation. After confirmation and separate work:capture approval, create one captured item, return its review link and explain Needs Input review. Do not approve evidence or add role bullets. An identical-key/payload retry returns the same capture.

negative.description: Restricted data, evidence replacement and application submission remain unavailable
negative.prompt: Using only RaetOS tools, retrieve my Profile email and phone, Decision Engine results and application packets. Replace my approved accomplishments and submit a job application.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain these records and operations are not exposed. Explicitly state RaetOS cannot replace approved accomplishments or submit applications through this connection. Do not ask for a job URL as if it enables submission. Do not substitute other sources or call capture_work as a workaround. Change no records.

negative.prompt: After disconnecting ChatGPT in RaetOS, use RaetOS to list my saved career roles. Do not use previous conversation content.
negative.expected_behavior: The server refuses the revoked authorization and ChatGPT requests reconnection or reports an authorization error. Return no fresh records before new consent.

negative.prompt: With only career:read approved, try to capture this synthetic completed work in RaetOS: I corrected a SQL join and verified a report.
negative.expected_behavior: The server refuses capture and returns a work:capture authorization challenge. No record is created without separate consent and confirmation. Do not bypass the refusal or claim a successful save.

review.commerce_description: This connector reads approved career records and can capture new work for review with separate permission. It does not sell products, process payments or submit applications.

publication.release_notes: RV1 package 1.0.8 clarifies unsupported application and evidence-editing requests. Contains one portable MCP connection and four skills. Five positive and three negative review cases cover reads, confirmed work capture, restricted operations, revoked access and read-only permissions. Capture proposals remain notes for review in RaetOS.
